requirements_provenance.derivation: Combined roster includes 14 animals; reward-switch logic excludes GCAMP2, GCAMP5, GCAMP6, GCAMP10, where GCAMP5 is absent from current combined roster. Notebook explicitly selects days 3,5,7,8,10,12,14. This derives expected switching identities but does not authenticate real-session inclusion.

Current get_timeseries_data defaults to 0..450 cm. Each trial uses reward-zone start, converts position and reward start via 2*pi*((p-min)/(max-min))-pi, subtracts, then wraps to [-pi,pi). Samples come from [start-1:stop-1] using trial_start_inds/teleport_inds; other samples retain NaN. This resolves current source mathematics, not historical identity.

requirements_provenance.derivation: Native loader additionally applies speed>=2 and lick-validity filtering even when these variables are not requested. Do not claim its output is a causal neural-only admission interface. Authenticated owner targets and separate query projection remain needed.

Score is mean cosine difference; the score docstring phrase 1 minus contradicts executable return. CircularRegression is projected-normal EM with random initialization and sin/cos embedding, predicted by atan2(first,second). Fig3 alpha=1e-4. Ordinary least-squares sin/cos regression is not the official baseline.

Official notebook bins RR position using 45 linspace edges and independently samples each set to its minimum occupied-bin count, sorts selected indices, and splits pre/post around zero-based trial29. Its random/block CV differs from the prospective chronological contract. Arbitrary weights cannot silently replace this procedure.

Official workflow uses serialized sess/multi_anim_sess/dayData objects and stochastic place-cell shuffle classifications. Independently qualified references, authenticated safe loading and calibrated tolerances remain required.
